name: Pendry Manhattan West
insider_take: Manhattan West's crown jewel sits atop one of NYC's newest neighborhoods, where Hudson Yards meets Hell's Kitchen in spectacular fashion.
whats_special: This ultra-modern tower occupies floors 25-39 of the Pendry Manhattan West building, offering unobstructed views of the Hudson River and city skyline. The hotel features New York's largest hotel ballroom and sits directly above the 7 subway extension, making it incredibly accessible despite being in this emerging district.
pro_tip: Book a west-facing room for stunning sunsets over the Hudson River, and time your visit during the holiday season when the nearby Hudson Yards' Vessel installation is beautifully illuminated.
dont_miss: The rooftop bar Bar Pendry offers 360-degree views of Manhattan, while the ground-level restaurant Zou Zou's serves Eastern Mediterranean cuisine in a Instagram-worthy setting. Walk two blocks to explore the High Line elevated park or catch a show at the nearby Javits Center.
pros: Prime Manhattan West location near Hudson Yards and High Line
Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated amenities
Multiple dining venues including rooftop bar with city views
State-of-the-art fitness center and wellness facilities
cons: Newer property still establishing service reputation
